description: In session.rs, sieve_delivery takes 10 positional arguments (data, peer_ip, helo, mail_from, rcpt_list, auth_user, authenticator, dns_cache, sieve_cache, store). This is a strong signal that the function is doing too much or that its context should be bundled into a struct. Long argument lists are hard to call correctly (argument transposition bugs), hard to read, and painful to extend. Fix: group related parameters into a DeliveryContext struct passed by reference, reducing the signature to 2-3 arguments.
title: smtp: sieve_delivery has 10-argument function signature
